reviews.text: Great experience for my dog and they explained everything to me. Very attentive and friendly staff!

Absolutely. Here’s a more complete version that includes the whole team and grooming:

We have had such a great experience with Woodlawn Animal Hospital. Dr. Harris has been amazing with Lovie, and her entire team is wonderful. Everyone is caring, attentive, and always makes us feel welcomed. The customer service is consistently great, and I truly appreciate the care they provide.

And I have to mention the grooming! Lovie gets the BEST grooms here. She always comes home looking and smelling amazing.

It means so much to have a place where I feel confident that Lovie is well cared for, whether she’s there for a visit or a groom. We truly appreciate Dr. Harris and the entire Woodlawn Animal Hospital team!

We appreciate the exceptional care and service from Dr. Allyson Harris and team.  We appreciate the safe healthy environment now and during COVID.  The peace of mind is priceless.  Thank you for all you all do for us.  QuinnAgain and Cocoa.
Fergus loves going here for visits and boarding! The staff is amazing!
has chief keef been in ur hospital huh?
Excellent cleaning 👍 …
Excellent standards and customer service. Pricey though. $32 for nail clippings. My regular vet is $18 and if I'm getting several services done, the nail clipping is complementary.
Took my dog here for a quick checkup kept hearing firecrackers outside but overall good would reccomend

Your response doesn’t change my experience. I understand you have policies regarding walk-ins, but policies are not an excuse for poor customer service. The issue was never that I expected to be seen immediately. The issue was how I was treated from the moment I arrived.

Instead of making me feel welcomed as a potential new client, I was met with someone barely opening the door, speaking to me from outside, and making me feel like I wasn’t welcome in your facility. That’s the impression your staff gave me, and that’s why I chose to leave.

You can explain your policies all you want, but customer service is about how people are treated. I found another veterinary hospital that welcomed me professionally, and they earned my business. I stand by my review because it accurately reflects my experience.

⭐☆☆☆☆

I stopped by to make an appointment for my dog, but the experience left me with a bad first impression. Instead of feeling welcomed, I felt like I was being kept at a distance. An employee only cracked the door open, stuck her head out, and started giving me instructions without inviting me inside. The interaction came across as cold and unwelcoming.

I’ve been to other veterinary clinics where the staff greeted me, made me feel comfortable, and were happy to answer my questions. Unfortunately, that wasn’t my experience here. Because of how I was treated before I could even schedule an appointment, I decided to take my dog to another animal hospital instead.

A first impression matters, especially when you’re trusting someone with your pet’s care. I hope they work on making new clients feel more welcome.

I visited Woodlawn Animal Hospital to have my cat treated for allergies. The team was very welcoming, friendly, and kind. They prioritized my cats comfort and Dr. Allyson was thorough in her care. I'll definitely be back with my other pets in the future.
The best vet I've taken my dog too. The doctor is very detailed, compassionate, and very skilled! 5 stars!

Very friendly and patient. They took their time and explained everything going on and took GREAT care of my best friend. I recommend Woodlawn Animal Hospital to all new and old pet owners. And the best part is that they are VERY affordable especially for the care they provide for both animal and parent. Definitely my first choice for all my best friend medical needs.
Iam truly amazed at the service & results I’ve gotten since I’ve switched back to them. I love how they actually care!!! I love them seriously, 10 stars

Great care and concern for our big Bernedoodle.  In fact he loves to go there to visit with the Vet staff there.  I highly recommend their service if you are in search of a knowledgeable and caring Veterinarian for your fur baby.
The staff was really professional and compassionate. The place was really clean. Thank you for your time and consideration.
Dr Harris and her staff are not only professional but also KIND. Best vet appointment I’ve had in my life and my doggy agrees.

If you are looking for a vet that truly cares and will help out instead of trying to squeeze out your money, then look no more. Woodlawn has been a breath of fresh air in a city that most of the veterinarian offices are trying to maximize their profits at the people's expense. Our dog had been struggling with some elevated bio markers, we took her to the typical corporate vet office and regretted ever stepping foot near them. After a while and doing research, we found Woodlawn animal hospital and from the minute I called, it felt human, I could tell they care about my dog and how we were truly worried. We took our dog in and they took excellent care of her, the follow up treatment was great and I always get the feeling of community. Our dog is doing great and will continue to take her to Woodlawn animal hospital for veterinarian needs.
saw king von and Durk 5 stars recomend

First time visiting a veterinary and I must say I am more than pleased. The staff are extremely polite, helpful, and paient. They will answer any and all questions you have so don't be afraid to ask. Unfortunately I cried even though it wasn't me on the table but the doctor paused and addressed my emotions right then. They not only take care of your fur baby but the pet parent as well.
Dr Harris & Staff take care of our family dogs very well

My only regret is that I cannot give them 6 stars. Dr. Harris and her staff are the most professional practice anywhere, everything explained in detail, all questions answered, and my dog is extremely comfortable with them. Kindness, compassion, professionalism, that's why this is the only veterinarian practice that I utilize.

Dr.Harris is THEEEE BEST. Dr. Harris and her beautiful staff made the process for my fur son so easy.

Thank you Dr. Harris

Spent 5 minutes asking for cost to bring the dog in and would not stop trying to give me a bunch of other info without a single price attached like saying vaccines need to be up to date and that there could be unknown costs. Like I get it I don't need the extra info my dog is hurt either give me a price window of 100-1000 or something don't just keep dragging out a call without offering info then tell me there is a fee for diagnosis and that you can tell me that as well but first you need to tell me other stuff????
No get to the fee already we don't need a back and forth conversation. How much to get seen. That's what I need
Dr. Harris is the best! She made sure to explain each part of the exam and made sure both of my dogs were comfortable enough before moving to the following procedure❤️!

I will be taking all my dogs to Dr. Allyson from now on. The entire staff is so kind, caring, and knowledgeable. Unbeknownst to me, My 9 week old puppy came from the breeder with parvo and a worm infestation. Everyone at Woodlawn Animal Hospital treated my baby like he was theirs. They saved my baby. I will always be grateful for the treatment I received as a patron and the treatment my baby received while he was under their care.
Woodlawn Animal Hospital has been our vet for years now and their service is always excellent. The vet and staff really care about my dog’s wellbeing and they’ve always been super helpful.

Shout out to the receptionist who connected me with a vet clinic in Illinois that had an ultrasound machine for my fur baby. She could have easily told me that they could not service my dog and hung up. Instead, she stayed on the line until I had all the information necessary to be serviced at a clinic that could provide everything my dog needed. Didn't get your name, but you know who you are! Thank you!

They don't let you come to sign in when you show up. You can't ring doorbell upon arrival. You have to say in your car. You have to call to check in when you get there it's so inconvenient. Only have one vet on duty. Place is too small. I'd advise going elsewhere.

Overpriced/ poor customer service

I took my 2 kittens in for a wellness check on Friday 11/25. I thought they would get vaccines, wellness exam,  & stool  exam.
I was told they're on a contactless visit schedule.  Nobody is the inside of the facility.  Ok.
The nurse/doctor called as she was with my kittens.  She told me they're 10 weeks old,  playful,  energetic, and checked out fine except for a few fleas found on them. The stool came back negative of any parasites or worms. I paid $280 for the visit.
Got my kitty's home they was tired, but I noticed 1 scratching.  Odd, they wasn't scratching prior to visit.
Next day the other started scratching.  Ok, now I'm concerned, but maybe its the flea medicine.  Sunday both are scratching noticeably.  I call and leave a message, surely they must have gotten something from there,  this behavior wasn't shown prior to having them seen there.  I missed your call, so  I briefly scan the  voice text  left and see a nasty message about strays having all kinds of problems when you pick them up from the streets.  I stopped reading and called.
I spoke to an unnamed person on the phone who then went back and forth with me about my kittens being infested with fleas when they were seen by the vet.
I reminded them about what was told to me while my kittens was being examined, and how did a "few fleas" become "an infestation " & "farm kittens" become "strays off the street" they retracted  that statement.  Then proceeded  to tell me they should be reexamined again by the doctor because they was not scratching during their visit.  Ok so we both agreed, this is new behavior immediately following  their visit.
I then was placed on hold to schedule an appointment.
We agreed on a day and time for the appointment and then she told me my visit would be $85 per kitten, because I was presenting a different issue so I had to pay again.
What????? I just paid for a wellness check and they was visibly well prior to the check,  and during their exam according to both me and the doctor, so why would I have to pay again.
She sais, because the doctor is to reexamine them, and that's a different issue then their last visit,  that's why.
They won't be coming back yand cancel the 2 week appointment as well,  and forward me and medical records.
We can't give you have records,  we can only give them to another hospital once you take them there.
Excuse me!
I paid you, not another hospital and if you can't give them to me, then refund me my money i spent on their exams and vaccines.
She then tells me she'll have to talk to the doctor. That was monday 11/28/22, I haven't  received a return call.

I was so impressed by the professional caring staff at The Woodlawn Animal Hospital. I found my self in a crisis my dog Gucci and I called they listened and gave me an appointment. Upon arrival they were friendly and my dog is a handful but the care they took to calm my sick and not so nice baby was noted . This is my first pet but not first visit to the Vet . And was not met with negativity as I have previously when he is a little aggressive they knew how to attend to him and he was able to be treated. The care and professionalism I experienced will never be forgotten and he is healing and feeling better today due to that appointment. I love excellent customer service and will always acknowledge it and let it be known when I receive it . Gucci has a new place to be cared for and that’s Woodlawn Animal Hospital. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I have been taking my pets here for years and have always received nothing but the very best of services..
Woodlawn Animal Hospital has taken great care of my cat and the staff are really nice (to people and pets!)

Our first visit was great 👍 they took our 4yr old doberman in and treated him like family. He gets nervous when you trem his nails not here and on the exam table they made sure he was cool with it moving. This is a great place and he will be coming back... …
I absolutely LOVE Dr. Harris and her team, periodt. I KNOW that my lil shih tzu Oscar (and me) are in good hands and hearts at the Woodlawn Animal Hospital!! 💯💜🐕‍🦺 …

I have used this facility since 1987 Dr Harris has ben my vet from a Doberman, Terrier,  and 3 English Mastiffs. I will be introducing her to my 4th English Mastiff soon she is 11 weeks old  and this is the only place 1 trust ❤
Everyone is friendly and Dr Allyson is great to talk and knowledgable of her practice.

My dog has had several skin and general health issues over the past year. Woodlawn/Dr. Harris is the first vet that has taken time to really understand what was going on and after only 2 days of being on the meds and food she prescribed, I'm already seeing huge improvements! Dr. Harris and her staff are deeply knowledgeable, caring, and thorough. Highly recommend!
Techs are always calm and friendly. Information is clear when shared. My dog is not panicked when he goes in and comes out

What a wonderful place!  All of the techs AND the vets treat my pets as if they were their own.  They are gentle with them, patient with me and willing to address any and all questions and concerns that I may have.  I trust this place implicitly and have been a loyal customer since it was acquired by Dr. Diva (Harris).

The customer service is very good and the main reason is they treat my cat very good. I feel comfortable with them and decisions that have to be made. Im n the room with examinations and I like the way they interact with the animals and they are very knowledgeable. There is street parking. Payments are cash n credit. Small waiting area with seating and they are respectful with the animals coming in and out at the same time.  I usually don't have time issues with making appointments either.  I would recommend Woodlawn Animal
